title: Expose soft-body contact scopes
scope: Add versioned soft-body self-contact control, pair edge and exact scoped capability identities; advertise nothing.
acceptance: Registry, generated API and specification distinguish intrinsic self contact from separate-system surface contact.
Validation rejects invalid topology, duplicate/reversed edges and unsupported requests atomically.
evidence: PASS: tracked API and graph tests via ctest --test-dir /private/tmp/parallel-mater-p125-build --output-on-failure -j 4; 93/93 passed with 14 expected unadvertised CPU-domain skips; AppleClang 21/macOS ARM64.
PASS: tracked soft-body contact contract and graph-validation tests against Apple M4 Metal; invalid topology and reversed, duplicate, and unsupported requests preserved usable prior state.
PASS: exact CPython 3.13.15 reference check generated deterministic tracked API, specification, PDF, and ABI artifacts; 6 C11/C++17 ABI checks passed.
PASS: conformance evidence-index, manifest-sync, and qualification unit suites; 42 tests passed and both new soft-body contact capabilities remain unadvertised.
